verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly suggests worked material. There is a guide on running Llama on desktop and in other environments such as Jupyter (llama-docs-3, llama-docs-9), and an overview page refers to an example script that switches to Llama 3.1 via a --model-id parameter (llama-docs-16). Nothing shows an official cookbook or recipe repo with real end-to-end tasks, and the docs surface sits behind an SSO wall for keyless readers (llama-supp-docs-gated). Missing for 10: an evidenced official cookbook/recipes collection, end-to-end task examples (e.g., RAG, agents, fine-tuning) beyond setup guides, publicly readable docs, independent or hands-on corroboration that examples are adaptable.
